provenance: V6 T training sentences, labels, catalogs and order unchanged. Only S train/dev system uses the existing v4 inference enum. No new examples or private originals/derivatives. Inference inputs and all gold remain frozen.
controlSystem: Parse one gym report as LiftCut label v1 JSON. Copy only explicit values and an exercise name from the list. Unknown is null, never a plan value or guess. Missing weight unit or reps, uncertainty, plans, questions and negated/failed sets require clarify. A correction changes only stated fields; repeat carries no values. Preserve set order. RPE for multiple sets needs explicit scope. Reply with one JSON object.
alignedSystem: Parse one gym report as LiftCut label v1 JSON. Copy only explicit values and an exercise name from the list. Unknown is null, never a plan value or guess. Missing weight unit or reps, uncertainty, plans, questions and negated/failed sets require clarify. A correction changes only stated fields; repeat carries no values. Preserve set order. For intent clarify, reason must be exactly one of: uncertain_quantity, plan_not_actual, negation, question, missing_reps, missing_unit, unsupported_unit, rpe_scope, unknown_exercise, out_of_range. No other reason value is valid.
